notes: Editor header (CEO 10-16): Customize is in the header, first, and lit while it is open.
Editor header: Dark or Light left the header (it is switched once, for a white PC build); it is in Customize › Colors.
Editor header: the Size chip says the screen too (e.g. 2560 × 720 · XENEON EDGE).
Editor header: the Layout chip is a small drawing of the layout, no words; it opens this portal's layouts as picture tiles, and a pick changes the portal.
Portal right-click: no Rename. An added portal is renamed by clicking its name in the editor header, or in the Control Panel.
